serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Changing topics for now seems like the best option. 
You: A-Anyway, how is the business going?
Lady Annalie: Oh, so now you care? 
I’m starting to think that there’s no safe path on this minefield…
You: I always cared!
Lady Annalie: That’s so nice! Unfortunately, I don’t need your pity.
You: …
You: Could you give me some break? I’m trying to be nice…
Lady Annalie: Well, if that’s the case. Business is doing awfully. I might need to start working part-time if this keeps up. 
Yikes…
You: Is there a way for me to help?
Lady Annalie: What? Do you need more socks?
Lady Annalie: It’s something I need to deal with myself.
You: Well, if you change your mind you can always speak with me, ok?
Lady Annalie: Sureeeeee.
The look on her face isn’t changing. She’s still staring daggers at me…
I have to think of something different.
You: Would you mind going out with us? It’s been some time.
Lady Annalie: You sure are persistent.
You: Do I have a choice?
#Annalie.Eyes.closed+Annalie.Mouth.sad
Lady Annalie: Fine. It’s better than continuing this conversation. I will try enjoying this friendship while it still lasts.
You: Is there any particular place that you would like to go?
#Annalie.face.sad
Lady Annalie: Sorry, my mind is not into it right now. Whatever will do.
You: Right. See you later, then.
